integrity: The all-parameter conclusion is proved geometrically from the published sink-configuration cubical model; finite chain computations for cycle lengths from 3 through 12 are independent checks and are not presented as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two labeled particles on the standard cycle with at least three edges, with every vertex a sink; no claim for more particles, partial sink sets, or unordered spaces.
title: Two-particle all-vertex sink configurations of cycles
